items.t: Chile’s SQM Q3 profit triples on lithium price surge, but warns of lower Q4 prices
items.sum: Investing.com-- Chilean lithium producer Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile, or SQM, (NYSE:SQM) reported a 205% jump in third-quarter net income on Tuesday, as prices for the battery metal stayed far above year-ago levels, though it warned that market prices have since fallen sharply.
